description:
'Eun-hyung', the vice-president of the entire school, has a good-looking face, excellent grades, and a friendly personality.  
However, 'Eun-hyung' also had a different side.  
'Seung-gyu', who found out about this by chance, is embarrassed,  
but wants to keep interfering with 'Eun-hyeong', who is picky and lax...

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/failedlove), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/failedlove), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000064282), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11417833), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/64824203)
